title: Public transport concessions for tertiary and TAFE students
summary: This page provides information on public transport concessions available for tertiary and TAFE students in NSW.
intro: If you are a tertiary or TAFE student in NSW, you may be able to get cheaper public transport. Many students need two things:
who_can_apply: Must be an Australian citizen or permanent resident enrolled full-time in an approved higher education or vocational course (exceptions apply for students with disability who must study part-time or externally).
Must be an international student on one of the specified scholarships.

faqs.q: Who is eligible for public transport concessions?
faqs.a: You must live in NSW and be an Australian citizen or permanent resident enrolled full-time in an approved higher education or vocational course (exceptions apply for students with disability who study part-time or externally), or be an international student on a specific scholarship.

faqs.q: What types of concessions are available?
faqs.a: Concessions include the Transport Concession Entitlement Card, Concession Opal card, and regional travel options.

faqs.q: Where can I find more information about my concession?
faqs.a: You can check eligibility and details on the Transport for NSW website.
